Presidential Secretariat - Duties & Functions assigning to the Minister of Defence

This Extra Gazette has been amended and the new Extra Gazette No. is 1901/27
reasoning: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and outlines detailed portfolio responsibilities for the Minister of Defence, including specific duties/functions, departments/institutions under their purview, and laws to be implemented. It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
